'''Foran Tutha''' was a barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] on the edge of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Otherwise unremarkable and beneath notice, Foran Tutha shot to prominence after the discovery of the [[Foran Tutha star probe]] in the system sometime around [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]]. Despite centuries of debate, academics never came to an agreement on the nature of the probe's origins. In the millennia after the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]], Foran Tutha hosted a cottage industry of treasure hunters that made the dangerous jumps in the direction of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
